run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T01:32:17Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by real errors: frontend-proxy 'ingress' spans carrying http.status_code=504 (otel.status_code=ERROR) with durations pinned at ~15,000,000 us appear from about 01:33:17Z, peak at 0.148 of the 5m error-span share at 01:39:17Z, and match the alert's 0.0667 at 01:40:17Z. The failing requests are /api/recommendations: the frontend's own 'grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations', 'executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations' and 'GET /api/recommendations' spans had p90 = 15000 ms at 01:39:17Z versus 79-197 ms at 01:20:00Z, while every other frontend operation stayed sub-second; the frontend still answered 200, so the 504s are the proxy timing out on those slow responses. The deepest cause the evidence supports is CPU stress injected into the recommendation pod: Chaos Mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress' (namespace chaos-mesh) spawned a StressChaos every minute from 01:29:13Z to at least 01:37:13Z, each recording 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv/recommendation', and in that period the pod's CPU usage rose from ~0.024 to ~0.192 cores and its CFS throttled-period ratio from ~5% to ~97%, while recommendation span p90 went from 11-25 ms to 320 ms (01:33:17Z) and above the largest 15000 ms bucket from 01:34:17Z onward. Other services' p90 at 01:39:17Z were at or below their 01:20:00Z values (accounting was already ~1.9 s at baseline), so a cluster-wide slowdown is not supported. A separate fraud-detection OOMKill episode ended at 01:12:20Z, before the error deviation, and all flagd feature flags read 'off', so neither explains this alert.

claims.text: frontend-proxy error spans (traces_span_metrics_calls_total, span_name='ingress', status_code='STATUS_CODE_ERROR') were ~0 before 01:32:17Z, then read 0.0259 at 01:33:17Z, 0.0963 at 01:35:17Z, 0.1481 at 01:39:17Z, 0.0667 at 01:40:17Z (the value in the alert annotation) and 0 at 01:44:17Z; span_name='router frontend egress' showed no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series at all in this window.

The frontend-proxy error spans are HTTP 504 timeouts: 'ingress' spans of service frontend-proxy (service_version 2.1.3) carry status_tags {error:true, http.status_code:"504", otel.status_code:"ERROR"} with durations of ~15,000,700 us, and their child 'router frontend egress' spans carry {error:"true", http.status_code:"0"} with the same ~15,000,500 us duration.

The 504 traces are /api/recommendations requests: in the same sampled traces the load-generator 'GET' spans carry {error:true, http.status_code:"504"} and the frontend spans are 'GET /api/recommendations', 'executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations' and 'grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations' lasting 15-22 s and ending with http.status_code 200 / rpc.grpc.status_code 0.

At 01:39:17Z frontend span p90 (traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket) was exactly 15000 ms for 'grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations', 'GET /api/recommendations' and 'executing api route (pages) /api/recommendations', versus 79.3 ms, 196.7 ms and 192.5 ms at 01:20:00Z; in the same two instants the other frontend operations stayed in the tens-to-hundreds of ms range (e.g. grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 194.8 ms vs 81.9 ms, GET /api/products/{productId} 89.6 ms vs 87.1 ms).

The recommendation service's own span-duration p90 was 11.1 ms at 01:20:00Z (24.6/17.8 ms earlier in the window), rose to 320 ms at 01:33:17Z and then returned NaN from 01:34:17Z through 01:43:17Z, which for this histogram (finite buckets ending at le=15000.0, plus +Inf) means the 90th percentile exceeded 15000 ms.

Pod recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv (namespace otel-demo) CPU usage rose from ~0.024 cores before 01:29Z to 0.128 cores at 01:32:17Z and 0.1918 cores at 01:34:17Z, held ~0.191 cores through 01:39:17Z, then fell to 0.0238 cores at 01:44:17Z; the same pod's CFS throttled-period ratio rose from ~0.05 (baseline) to 0.306 at 01:30:17Z, 0.70 at 01:32:17Z and ~0.96-0.98 from 01:34:17Z onward.

Chaos Mesh events in namespace chaos-mesh show Schedule 'otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress' spawning a StressChaos object every minute (otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress-jn58v 01:29:13Z, -gwd9j 01:30:13Z, -tq59h 01:31:13Z, -lwlmp 01:32:13Z, -h7zr7 01:33:13Z, -6p484 01:34:13Z, -vmtj8 01:35:13Z, -flf8h 01:36:13Z, -q55wg 01:37:13Z), each reporting 'Experiment has started' and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv/recommendation', followed by 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos' about 55 s later.

Deployment recommendation in otel-demo runs 1 replica with container resources limits cpu=100m/memory=160Mi and requests cpu=30m/memory=80Mi; its pod recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv is Running and Ready with restartCount 0, so the pod was up while its CPU was throttled.

A cluster-wide latency change is not supported: at 01:39:17Z versus 01:20:00Z the span p90 of other services was equal or lower (checkout 90.6 vs 117.3 ms, cart 18.4 vs 54.6 ms, shipping 41.8 vs 73.9 ms, ad 1.91 vs 1.99 ms, product-catalog 1.93 vs 1.86 ms, payment 1.98 vs 1.95 ms, currency 3.9 vs 1.99 ms, email 4.97 vs 4.20 ms, image-provider 1.8 vs 1.8 ms, quote 1.82 vs 1.86 ms, fraud-detection 83.7 vs 84.9 ms); only recommendation (NaN i.e. >15 s vs 11.1 ms) and the frontend path through it degraded, and accounting was already slow at baseline (2569 ms vs 1917 ms).

ConfigMap flagd-config in otel-demo (key demo.flagd.json) has every flag at defaultVariant "off" — including recommendationCacheFailure, adFailure, adHighCpu, cartFailure, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems and loadGeneratorFloodHomepage — so no flag-driven fault or delay injection was in effect as configured.

Pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-dz8j9 (otel-demo) shows container fraud-detection with exit code 137 / last termination reason OOMKilled and restartCount 3, Ready since 01:12:20Z, with BackOff events 01:07:41Z-01:12:05Z; this ended before the frontend-proxy error-rate deviation that begins at 01:33:17Z.

Per-service STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate over 00:32:17Z-01:44:43Z shows frontend-proxy peaking at 0.148 and no comparable deviation elsewhere: fraud-detection read 0 except 0.0037 at 01:41:17Z and 01:43:17Z, frontend, cart and payment read 0 throughout, ad showed isolated 0.0037 readings, and recommendation 0.0037 at 01:35:17Z and 01:37:17Z (this series exists only for ad, cart, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment and recommendation).

Pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-p8qtl (otel-demo) is Running and Ready since 00:50:58Z with restartCount 0 and no OOMKilled container state, i.e. the proxy itself was up and serving while it returned 504s on the recommendation path.

The stable ~15 s ceiling on frontend-proxy ingress/egress spans and on the frontend recommendation spans suggests a 15 s upstream response timeout in frontend-proxy; the value could not be confirmed because no proxy configuration object is readable (otel-demo ConfigMaps are only flagd-config, otel-collector, product-catalog-products and kube-root-ca.crt).

The fraud-detection OOMKill/restart episode did not cause this alert: its restarts ended at 01:12:20Z, ~20 minutes before the frontend-proxy error rate left its ~0 baseline at 01:33:17Z, its own error-span rate stayed at 0 apart from 0.0037 readings, and the sampled 504 traces all run through /api/recommendations, not through fraud-detection.

Feature-flag fault injection (for example recommendationCacheFailure or adHighCpu) was considered as the trigger and rejected: the flagd-config ConfigMap read for otel-demo sets every flag's defaultVariant to "off".

Inspect the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress (namespace chaos-mesh) — its schedule, stress cpu workers/load, duration and historyLimit — and decide whether it should keep running; it is re-applying CPU stress to the only recommendation pod every minute.

Review the recommendation deployment's sizing (1 replica, limits cpu=100m/memory=160Mi, requests cpu=30m/memory=80Mi) and the frontend-proxy upstream timeout, so that a single CPU-starved pod cannot push /api/recommendations past the proxy timeout and produce 504s.

gaps: The Chaos Mesh custom resources themselves are unreadable in this Run: kubernetes_jq_query for kind 'stresschaos' was refused with INVALID_PARAMS, so the StressChaos stressor parameters (cpu workers/load), duration, scheduler interval and creation time of Schedule 'otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress' were not read; the fault application is known only from its events.

Kubernetes events returned cover only 01:12:05Z-01:37:21Z (source window of the query); nothing shows whether the Schedule fired before 01:29:13Z or kept firing after 01:37:13Z, although recommendation CPU was still elevated and its span p90 still above 15 s at 01:43:17Z.

Jaeger returned no traces at all for service 'recommendation' inside 01:30:00Z-01:44:43Z (empty result; the service is listed), so recommendation-side spans and any recommendation error status could not be inspected; its behaviour was assessed from traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket and container CPU metrics only.

rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket / rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count returned no series via get_metric_names in this window (status no_data), so gRPC-level client/server latency series were unavailable; latency was taken from traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket.
The 15 s timeout value used by frontend-proxy is not visible in any readable otel-demo ConfigMap, and no Envoy/proxy configuration object was readable, so the timeout hypothesis remains unconfirmed.
The change_history integration is not integrated, so who or what created Schedule 'otel-demo-recommendation-cpu-stress' and when could not be established.

Error-rate series exist only for services ad, cart, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment and recommendation; error rates for accounting, checkout, shipping, currency, email, image-provider, product-catalog and quote are unknown rather than zero.

frontend-proxy container logs were only partially examined (newest 40 of 4734 lines matching '504|error|timeout|upstream' returned 200/308 responses at 01:37:53-01:37:57Z; that log view is marked incomplete), so the log lines for the 504 responses themselves were not retrieved.
